rules.regex: ^(?:ho gaya|ho gya|hogya|kar diya|done|ready|fix hua|build hua|apk ready|kya hua|kitna hua|ab|aur|fir|phir|kab tak)\??$
rules.hint: This is a status/follow-up about the most recent active task. Answer with the latest verified state from recent context.
Resolve this reference to the most recent matching subject or result in conversation history.
Add the requested change to the current target while preserving existing accepted features.
Preserve all unrelated existing functions; make only the requested incremental change.
Prefer an incremental/hot update when the change can be represented as a runtime pack; otherwise distinguish in-place APK update from reinstall.
Interpret this as Anamika's owner-controlled self-upgrade workflow; preserve owner approval for final installation.
Treat this as an understanding/reply defect. Use the newest error plus recent conversation to identify whether parsing, model inference, context or timeout is failing.
Treat this as an app lifecycle/crash issue and use recent diagnostics/status instead of assuming a language problem.
Interpret this in wake/voice context unless the sentence clearly addresses Anamika conversationally.
Consider wake-listener audio ownership and media/call coexistence when diagnosing the issue.
Interpret this as app-discovery/automation capability context and preserve existing plugin/accessibility functions.
Use the latest verified repository/build state. Do not claim success while CI is still queued or running.
Interpret this as Android signing/update identity context. Same signing certificate is required for in-place APK updates.
Interpret this as Android local-build/toolchain compatibility context and keep min/target/OS-version meanings distinct.
Interpret this as Anamika's local coding/inference stack, not general cloud ChatGPT.
Recheck the current target comprehensively, but report only checks actually performed.
Answer the immediate question first before continuing implementation details.
Respond concisely with current result/status and continue the task without mirroring emotional wording.
If this is a numeric follow-up, reuse the immediately relevant figures and units from recent turns, then recompute.
Rewrite or translate the immediately relevant prior text into clear professional English.
Translate or rewrite the immediately relevant prior draft into natural Hindi/Hinglish according to context.
Merge the new content into the immediately preceding draft rather than starting a separate message.
Treat this as a follow-up to the most recent visual/design target and preserve accepted choices unless explicitly changed.
This likely belongs to the separate voice-chat app context; do not mix it with Anamika core unless explicitly requested.
Use the current platform/policy context and keep role/rate assumptions from the latest provided policy, not older rates.
Interpret this as a request for the latest verified downloadable artifact/link, not a request to rebuild unless the artifact is outdated or broken.
